title: Audit technical SEO with evidence
description: Inspect status codes, indexability, canonical URLs, metadata, internal links and structured data.
accomplishes: Inspect status codes, indexability, canonical URLs, metadata, internal links and structured data. Distinguish local code findings from live observations. Prioritise fixes and verification steps without guaranteeing rankings or requesting indexing for every unverified URL.
prompt:
Act as a web developer.

Task: Audit technical SEO with evidence.

Input context:
- WEBSITE: [WEBSITE]
- SITEMAP: [SITEMAP]
- CRAWL DATA: [CRAWL DATA]
- TARGET PAGES: [TARGET PAGES]

Inspect status codes, indexability, canonical URLs, metadata, internal links and structured data. Distinguish local code findings from live observations. Prioritise fixes and verification steps without guaranteeing rankings or requesting indexing for every unverified URL.

Preserve the existing architecture, minimise dependencies and define scope, acceptance criteria and relevant tests. Keep secrets server-side. No production changes or deployment without approval.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Technical audit outline
Compare sitemap entries with real pages and check that important routes return 200. Verify clean canonicals and deliberate handling of filtered URLs. Identify orphan links and conflicting directives. Record what was checked locally versus live. Correct implementation supports discovery but does not establish that Google has indexed or ranked the page.
